seams.title: Grant blitz to spells you cast, priced at their mana cost
seams.clause: Each creature spell you cast with mana value 4 or greater has blitz. The blitz cost is equal to its mana cost. / Blitz costs you pay cost {1} less for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
seams.why: A permanent cannot grant blitz: checkGrantedAlternativeCosts (server/internal/cards/effects/granted_alternative_cost.go, the o.Dash || o.Blitz || o.Sneak refusal) panics on a granted offer carrying Blitz, and game/granted_alternative_cost.go has no entry hook that applies blitz's haste, draw grant and end-step sacrifice off a granted key. Extend game.GrantedAlternativeCost the way granted evoke and granted warp were (GrantedAltCostEvoke, effects/granted_evoke.go): a 'granted-blitz' key with PricedAtManaCost, a MinManaValue 4 creature filter, the riders applied through game.ApplyBlitzRidersForEffect, and a reduction that applies to blitz costs only (printed and granted) counted from commander casts.
seams.checked: grep -i 'has blitz', 'GrantBlitz', 'blitz cost is equal' over effects+game comments: 0. grep Blitz in granted_alternative_cost.go: only the refusal (effects :383) and onlyMana (game :576). Precedents that DO exist: PricedAtManaCost (Herigast emerge), EvokeForSpellsYouCastFromHand, commander-cast counts ('cast your commander from the command zone this game' in 18 files, e.g. commanders_insight.go).

seams.title: Build casualty X with a modified copy
seams.clause: Casualty X. The copy isn't legendary and has starting loyalty X.
seams.why: Casualty(n) (server/internal/cards/effects/casualty.go) is a fixed 'creature with power n or greater' sacrifice, and the copy is the engine's own trigger (game/casualty.go resolveCasualty), which copies with no exceptions. Needed: a casualty cost whose N is announced as X (any creature may be sacrificed, X is its power, read from the sacrificed permanent's last-known power on PaidCost), and a copy exception on that trigger (not legendary, starting loyalty X) for a permanent-spell copy that becomes a token.
seams.checked: grep -i 'Casualty X', 'CasualtyX', 'casualty.*XValue' over effects+game: no implementation. Copy exceptions on spell copies exist elsewhere ('copy ... isn't legendary' in 31 files, double_major.go), and 'copy of a permanent spell becomes a token' in 17 files, so only the casualty trigger and the variable cost are missing. The Devil token of the -2 exists (pugnacious_pugilist.go, tibalt_rakish_instigator.go).

seams.title: Add 'untap N tapped creatures you control' as an activation cost
seams.clause: {W}, {T}, Untap a tapped creature you control: ... / {W}{W}, {T}, Untap two tapped creatures you control: ... / {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}, {T}, Untap fifteen tapped creatures you control: You win the game.
seams.why: game.AbilityCost (game/activated.go) has TapOthers (tap untapped permanents) but no component that untaps tapped ones. Add its mirror (an UntapOthers *TapOthersCost or a flag on TapOthersCost), with the picker wording, the enumerator in server/internal/legal and the protocol list it rides on.
seams.checked: Listed every field of AbilityCost: Tap, TapOthers, Waterbend, Sacrifice*, Mana*, Life*, Energy*, Loyalty*, Crew, Saddle, RemoveCounters, AddCounter, Blight, Discard*, Reveal*, ReturnToHand, Exile*, ReturnSelf, BottomSelf, *Grantor, UnattachEquipment, Exert, PutFromHandOnLibraryTop, ExileFromLibraryTop, Mill, Either, Forage: none untaps. grep 'Untap (a|two|X|four) tapped' and 'UntapOthers|UntapTapped' over effects+game: 0.

seams.title: Let a cast permission ask for a creature sacrifice in addition
seams.clause: Once during each of your turns, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your graveyard by sacrificing a creature in addition to paying its other costs. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead.
seams.why: game.CastPermission (game/cast_permission.go ~:782-835) carries SacrificeLandInAddition, SacrificeNonlandPermanentInAddition, LifeInAddition and RemoveCountersInAddition, each a fixed clause; there is no 'sacrifice a creature' one. Add the sibling (or generalise to a TargetSpec) beside them. The rest of the card has precedents: 'Once during each of your turns, you may cast' (16 files), 'If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead' (finale_of_promise.go).
seams.checked: grep 'InAddition' in game/cast_permission.go: only the four fields above. grep 'sacrific(e|ing) a creature in addition' over effects+game: 0. Falco Spara's 'by removing a counter from a creature you control' is NOT part of this seam: RemoveCountersInAddition (dawnhand_dissident.go) with N=1 on PlayFromTopOfYourLibrary (into_the_pit.go) covers it; it is a watch item in batch 20.
